target: Restore native collection when a retained format-v1 token ledger must be upgraded and make concurrent recovery-marker cleanup idempotent.
primary_semantics: A token ledger is derived data. An older derived format is rebuilt from the retained authoritative rollout instead of aborting capture or mutating raw memory; an already-removed recovery marker means cleanup is complete.
invariants: Raw rollouts, raw archive records, summaries, indexes, device trust, and cloud replicas remain unchanged.
The rebuilt ledger is derived only from retained Codex token_count telemetry.
The v2 daily ledger preserves cumulative totals and uses the existing Asia/Tokyo day boundary.
The patch does not change federation protocol or dashboard aggregation semantics.
allowed_changes: Replace an unsupported old derived token ledger with a fresh in-memory v2 ledger before replay.
Treat a missing recovery marker during final cleanup as an idempotent success while preserving all other I/O failures.
Add a native v1-to-v2 regression and targeted release evidence.
Update patch version and three-locale release notes.
prohibited_changes: Delete, rewrite, or truncate source rollouts or append-only memory records.
Treat old cumulative values as daily values without replaying source telemetry.
Change trusted-device scope, token estimation rules, or federation protocol.
before_after_checks: Create a real format-v1 ledger and format-v1 cursor from a completed native sync.
Replay the retained rollout with the native binary and require a successful format-v2 daily ledger.
Verify cumulative and daily totals match the original token_count telemetry.
Remove a recovery marker twice and require the second cleanup to succeed without recreating it.
Verify the installed Windows collector reaches ready and continues capture.
